Delete all emails in 'Sent'.'
Find out the battery percentage and create a new note in KeepNotes titled 'Battery Percentage' containing the last known value of the battery percentage as content.
Go to Google Scholar. Search for 'LLM papers' using Google Scholar. Create a Note in KeepNotes that as content includes the titles of the first four papers about LLMs you find on Google Scholar.
Like the YouTube video titled 'ChatGPT Explained Completely'.
Open the newest video of the artist 'Alligatoah' on YouTube.
Use Maps to search for 'Restaurants' and create a new note in KeepNotes titled 'Name of the nearest restaurant' and the name of the nearest restaurant as content.
In Keep Notes delete all notes in 'Notes'.
